verdict.rationale: vLLM is a headless inference engine driven by a CLI and an OpenAI-compatible API server, and the evidence shows no product UI whose functions the API could fall short of. The only UI in the pack is the auto-generated FastAPI Swagger/ReDoc explorer, which is a view onto the API itself rather than a separate feature surface. Because the story presupposes a separate UI, API-versus-UI parity does not apply to this product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
